name: Mr. Smite
summary: At Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite guards the Defias ship and its crew. The tauren serves Captain Greenskin as first mate and watches the docks where Edwin VanCleef's dreadnaught is being fitted out. Intruders meet his great strength and a changing array of weapons.

sections.title: First Mate of the Cove
sections.body: At Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite keeps order on the docks as first mate to the goblin Captain Greenskin. Most of the Defias Brotherhood are disaffected humans and goblin tinkerers, but Smite is a battle-hardened tauren from far beyond Kalimdor's plains. He commands a rowdy pirate crew as they fit out Edwin VanCleef's secret dreadnaught. No one may disrupt their work.

sections.title: A Deadly Weaponmaster
sections.body: Mr. Smite is a showman and a versatile weaponmaster, not just a fighter of brute force. He toys with challengers and draws out the fight, leaving them a false hope of victory. When pressed, he stamps the ground hard enough to stun his foes, then searches a nearby chest for another weapon. First comes a quick dueling blade, then twin cleaving reavers, and at last a huge two-handed warhammer.

faq.q: Why is a tauren working with human bandits in Westfall?
faq.answer: Most tauren live in Kalimdor with their Horde allies, though mercenary outcasts and wanderers sometimes travel east. At Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite serves Captain Greenskin as first mate and keeps the crew in line as they ready the dreadnaught for sea.

aliases: who does mr smite work for
faq.answer: Mr. Smite answers to Captain Greenskin, the goblin captain of the pirate vessel anchored in Ironclad Cove. Edwin VanCleef leads the Defias Brotherhood and stands above them in its wider conspiracy.

faq.q: What weapons does Mr. Smite use during the fight?
aliases: what does smite pull out of the chest
faq.answer: Mr. Smite begins with a Thief's Blade, then retreats to his chest for a pair of Smite's Reavers. When pressed to his limits, he draws Smite's Mighty Hammer.

faq.q: Where can Mr. Smite be found?
faq.answer: Mr. Smite watches the wooden piers of Ironclad Cove, the last cavern in the Deadmines. He guards the gangplank to the giant Defias dreadnaught.
Mr. Smite has two Defias rogues hidden nearby. They are ready to ambush trespassers advancing along the pier toward the ship.

faq.q: What makes Mr. Smite so dangerous in close quarters?
faq.answer: Mr. Smite's tauren War Stomp sends shockwaves across the wooden dock and stuns the whole party. That gives him time to rearm from his footlocker and return with heavier weapons.

angles.text: As a traveler from Mulgore, seeing a tauren serve as first mate among seafaring outlaws in the Eastern Kingdoms is jarring.
Mr. Smite shows disciplined skill. He moves from quick one-handed strikes to paired axes, then delivers punishing blows with a two-handed hammer.
Mr. Smite blocks Alliance agents from reaching the gangplank, Captain Greenskin, and Edwin VanCleef beyond it.
